items.title: Somalia at ‘real risk of famine’ as Middle East war fallout continues
items.description: At least six million people in Somalia are going days without enough food, UN aid teams warned on Friday, highlighting that nearly two million of this number are young children “at high risk of illness or death”.

items.title: Kyiv in mourning after 24 killed in strike as Russia, Ukraine exchange POWs
items.description: Ukraine's capital Kyiv declared a day of mourning Friday following a Russian attack that killed at least 24 people, including three children. Simultaneously, Moscow and Kyiv exchanged 205 prisoners of war from each side.

items.title: 'The Strike Hit Right Above Us': A Night Under Russian Bombs In Dobropillya
items.description: Russia is preparing to assault the city of Dobropillya, according to Ukraine’s military. Located a few kilometers from the front line, the city is burning and being destroyed by bombs, artillery, and drones. Despite daily shelling, some civilians flatly refuse to leave and remain in Dobropillya.

items.title: Death toll in attack on Kyiv apartment building now stands at 24
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Friday that a Russian missile attack on a Kyiv apartment building the previous day killed 24 people, including three children.
